project.name: masayume
project.productType: consumer prediction-market app on Somnia (Yosuku source-led port over DreamDEX Event Contracts)

design.colorMode: dark-first, light via [data-theme=light] remapping --white to #141210 (cream ground)

typography.display: Sora (var(--font-display)), extrabold, tight tracking for figures
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono (var(--font-mono)) for labels, 9–10px uppercase tracked 0.14–0.18em
typography.body: utility classes type-body / type-caption / type-data / type-label-micro

shadows.policy: none; hairline borders and surface steps carry depth

design.density: compact, editorial: mono micro-labels, big display figures, hairlines

patterns: the Ticket: side segments → stake → chips → quote strip → CTA
BlockedButton: the blocker is the CTA's label
rows: status · market · cadence · countdown · figures

must: keep Yosuku's palette and fonts exactly
no hex or px literals in TSX (design-literals invariant) — values live in a CSS module with the source utility named above each rule
theme-aware: never var(--white) on a non-flipping surface
every figure is a real chain reading or a named loading/unavailable state
avoid: framer-motion for one component (motion is acceptable once it is a project-wide choice)

decisions.decision: The user asked for a redesign pass with 21st.dev: same colours, better animation and clearer breakdowns, starting with the leverage/boost surfaces; verbatim Yosuku replication now yields on layout and motion.

Leverage surfaces: BoostCard (breakdown card: multiple + line, composition bar, one rolling payout figure, facts, knock-out meter, the reference's sentence), KnockoutMeter (track/fill/threshold), Odometer (spring count-up on base units, settles exactly), chips with a sliding highlight. Patterns from 21st: unlumen/count-up, ruixen.ui/segmented-button-group, hero_ui/heroui-meter. motion added project-wide; reduced motion honoured.
